interpretation: Relaxed mandatory-region lower bound, not measured runtime, WCET or proof of speedup. The current configuration is 50kHz: 20us/4000 CPU cycles at 200MHz, with 1628 cycles from ISR entry to the next ZERO deadline. The 4910-group floor already exceeds the entire 4000-cycle period, so revision6 remains ineligible for real-time operation at this configuration. Comparing this lower bound with an earlier lower bound cannot establish speedup.
